# Setup {.unnumbered}

You need R and a C++ build toolchain: [Rtools](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/) on Windows, [R development tools](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/tools/) on macOS.

## Run the check

Clone the [repository](https://github.com/mkoslovsky/SSC) and start R in its root directory. Run:

```r
source("./scripts/setup.R")
source("./examples/00-setup/run.R")
```

The final message should be `Rcpp + RcppArmadillo check passed: 6`.

## Source code

[examples/00-setup/sum.cpp](../examples/00-setup/sum.cpp) uses Armadillo to sum a vector and exposes the function to R:

```{.cpp include="../examples/00-setup/sum.cpp"}
```
